{{Top|leg}}
'''Hoska''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Hoska once came across a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] based on [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]] who coated the walls of their fortress with a resin created by a local form of wildlife. The resin was slick, and served as a deterrent to anyone attempting to breach the base using [[Tube-Launched Grapple]]s.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
